faqs.question: What is the consultation fee and appointment process?
faqs.answer: Dent-O-Care Complete Dental Clinic offers an affordable, transparent standard OPD consultation fee. You can book directly via WhatsApp at +91 98115 45717.

faqs.question: What are the clinic operating hours in Shalimar Bagh?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM - 1:30 PM and 5:30 PM - 8:00 PM. The clinic is closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Will a root canal treatment be painful?
faqs.answer: No. Our clinical team utilizes effective local anesthesia and modern rotary instruments so the root canal process is smooth, comfortable, and painless.

faqs.question: How long do zirconia dental crowns last?
faqs.answer: Zirconia crowns are extremely strong and chip-resistant. With good oral hygiene and regular dental checkups, they provide years of reliable chewing.

faqs.question: What sterilization measures are followed at Dent-O-Care?
faqs.answer: We adhere strictly to multi-tier autoclave vacuum sterilization for all instruments. Every tool set is sealed and opened fresh chairside.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic located in Shalimar Bagh?
